name: RC-B10-0366/2025 – After § 6 – Am 6
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
part_text: 6c. Welcomes the Colombian Government’s commitment and efforts to building peace and calls on the authorities to continue efforts to find a negotiated solution to the conflict; urges the EU and its Member States to accompany the current dialogues between the Colombian Government and armed actors, insisting on the need to respect international humanitarian law, as a sign of goodwill; considers that building a stable and lasting peace in Colombia beyond the resolution of the internal armed conflict should be a top priority for the EU and the international community;
